title: Track integrity check false-positive: accept event==closeout as CLEAN, not just completed==true
signal: Track integrity check false-positive: closeout-event track entries use event+summary schema (no turn or completed fields). Wakeup check tests completed==true which fails, flagging valid closeout sessions as INTERRUPTED. Fix: check for event==closeout OR completed==true when determining track health.
rationale: False INTERRUPTED detection causes unnecessary recovery prompts at wakeup, erodes trust in the integrity check, and may cause redundant recovery work.
delivery_note: Applied to this spoke: session-start.sh + wai.md fixed (signal 1); pre-compact.sh + user-prompt-submit.sh already implemented (signal 2)
